_about: The agreed winter load curve (CLAUDE.md, agreed 6 Oct 2026) as data, read by volume_check.py. Hand-maintained by coach sessions: change it when Shep agrees a change, never to make a flag go away. Monthly ranges ramp linearly from the first to the last day of the month.

ramp._about: How fast a week may climb towards the curve when it is below it (a return from injury or illness). The curve's own slope governs once he is on it.

holds.reason: Calf return: the week of 9 Nov is easy by agreement (8 Nov). The November step starts once the calf has had a week of normal running.
